unsplash.name: Unsplash License
unsplash.notes: Free for commercial and noncommercial use, no permission needed, attribution not required but appreciated ("Photo by Name on Unsplash"). Not allowed: selling photos without significant modification, or compiling Unsplash photos to replicate a similar or competing service. Per the Unsplash Terms the license does not cover trademarks, logos or brands in a photo, or the likeness of recognizable people, so permission may be needed depending on use. Only free photos are listed here; Unsplash+ photos (plus.unsplash.com) use a different license and are excluded.
unsplash.hotlinking: Unsplash asks API users to hotlink images.unsplash.com URLs so views count for the photographer (https://help.unsplash.com/en/articles/2511271-guideline-hotlinking-images, https://unsplash.com/api-terms). This library was picked by hand, not through the API, but the demos hotlink anyway. Keep the photo-... path, change only size parameters.

pexels.name: Pexels License
pexels.notes: All photos free to use and modify, attribution not required but appreciated ("Photo by Name on Pexels"). Not allowed: showing identifiable people in a bad light or offensive way, selling unaltered copies, implying endorsement by people or brands in the image, redistributing on stock or wallpaper platforms, or using a photo as part of a trademark, business name or logo. The Pexels Terms (last updated November 15, 2024) say permissions for identifiable people, logos and brands are the user's responsibility.
pexels.hotlinking: The license does not address hotlinking. The Pexels API returns images.pexels.com URLs for display and asks apps to credit Pexels and photographers (https://www.pexels.com/api/documentation/). Checked 2026-09-29: images.pexels.com serves these URLs to any referrer with Access-Control-Allow-Origin *.
